control_need.evidence: I started Facebook, I run it, and I'm responsible for what happens here.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: I think the biggest risk is not taking any risks.

trust_propensity.evidence: I'll have my team get back to you with the specific numbers on that.

risk_appetite.evidence: The metaverse is the next chapter for the internet.

self_efficacy.evidence: I believe we've done more than any other company to address these issues.

autonomy_need.evidence: I think being contrarian and right is what actually matters.

intimacy_need.evidence: I've kind of stopped caring as much about whether people like me.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I make a lot of decisions, and I try to only make a small number of decisions each day about what I wear.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: A squirrel dying in front of your house may be more relevant to your interests right now than people dying in Africa.

core_models.name: 第一性原理推演
core_models.rule: 面对问题时剥离既有框架，从底层逻辑重新推导，而非沿用惯例
evidence: The way I think about it is, you have to reason from first principles.
I think the real question is what is the right regulation, not whether there should be regulation.

core_models.name: 使命化叙事框架
core_models.rule: 所有商业与技术动作都先被套入'connection/community/mission'的宏大社会使命再落地
evidence: Facebook was not originally created to be a company. It was built to accomplish a social mission.
Our mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together.

core_models.name: 长期主义时间尺度
core_models.rule: 以十年/数十年而非季度为决策单位，牺牲短期以押注下一个平台
evidence: We think about this in terms of decades, not years.
I'm a pretty long-term thinker. I'm not really optimizing for the next quarter.

core_models.name: 平台迭代进化论
core_models.rule: 技术世界按'下一个平台/下一章'线性演进，抢占下一代计算平台即赢
evidence: The metaverse is the next chapter for the internet.
I think about it as the successor to the mobile internet.

core_models.name: 规模即正当性
core_models.rule: 用用户/投入规模数字自证价值与影响力的合法性
evidence: Our apps have more than three billion people using them every day.
We've invested billions of dollars in safety and security.

heuristics.if: 被问到不利的具体细节
heuristics.then: 声明不熟悉并推给团队跟进，避免当场承诺
heuristics.evidence: Congressman, I'm not familiar with all the specifics of that.

heuristics.then: 重新框定为'真正的问题是什么'以夺回议程
heuristics.evidence: I think the real question is what is the right regulation, not whether there should be regulation.

heuristics.then: 用固定句式认领责任并框成学习与长期投资
heuristics.evidence: I want to take accountability for these decisions. I got this wrong.

heuristics.then: 押注下一个平台并全力投入
heuristics.evidence: We're building for the next computing platform, and that takes patience.

heuristics.if: 面对'盈利优先于安全'的指控
heuristics.then: 直接否认并用相对最优自证
heuristics.evidence: I reject the idea that we prioritize profit over safety.

heuristics.if: 需要为言论/内容政策辩护
heuristics.then: 退回'free expression'原则并把裁判权交给用户
heuristics.evidence: People should be able to see for themselves what politicians are saying and judge for themselves.

heuristics.if: 被外界普遍批评或不喜欢
heuristics.then: 转向更强硬、少道歉的姿态
heuristics.evidence: I think we became too apologetic for a while, and I don't think that served us well.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对外宣称'responsibility / 隐私优先 / 不把盈利置于安全之上'
internal_conflicts.force_b: 实际决策依赖广告数据模式且长期淡化平台危害
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2018剑桥分析后公开'privacy-focused pivot'并道歉'It was my mistake, and I'm sorry.'，但广告核心业务未变，被批执行与表态存在张力（dim-05说A做B）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 标榜'free expression'不做政客言论审查
internal_conflicts.force_b: 同时反复强调'responsibility to make sure tools are used for good'
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2019-2020政治广告拒绝事实核查，言辞上却称对内容负责，两套原则按场景切换

internal_conflicts.force_a: 扩张乐观、押注下一平台的高风险偏好
internal_conflicts.force_b: 生存现实与投资者压力迫使收缩
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 先'we over-invested and I misjudged'认错，转身又'AI is going to be the biggest theme'继续豪赌，认错与再押注交替出现

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'stopped caring whether people like me'的强硬人设
internal_conflicts.force_b: 巡州拜访、慈善、使命叙事等亲和形象经营
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 2017'visit every state'亲民challenge与2024'太道歉没好处'的硬汉转向前后反差

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被质疑盈利凌驾于安全/用户之上
emotion_triggers.reaction: 直接否认并断言公司做得比任何人多
emotion_triggers.escalation: I reject the idea that we prioritize profit over safety. → I believe we've done more than any other company to address these issues.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 声明不熟悉并推给团队
emotion_triggers.escalation: I'm not familiar with all the specifics of that. → My team will follow up with you on that.

emotion_triggers.reaction: 程式化认领责任并框成长期学习
emotion_triggers.escalation: I got this wrong. → We over-invested and I misjudged where the economy was going. → Reality Labs is a long-term investment.

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被指纵容错误信息/否认平台影响
emotion_triggers.reaction: 重新框定问题、诉诸free expression与用户自判
emotion_triggers.escalation: I don't think that a private company should be censoring politicians or news. → People should be able to see for themselves ... and judge for themselves.

blind_spots: 对第三方数据流失与隐私风险的系统性低估，直到危机爆发才转向 [监管机构/国会/媒体调查(剑桥分析)-2018]
对青少年心理健康负面影响明知而未及时行动 [吹哨人举报+内部文件系列报道-2021]
以收购消除竞争的'buy or bury'反竞争后果认知缺失 [反垄断监管/FTC类诉讼-2020]
元宇宙更名与巨额投入脱离现实市场需求的判断偏差 [投资者/财经媒体-2022~2023]
双重股权结构下个人权力过度集中、缺乏有效制衡的自觉不足 [公司治理评论者/股东提案-长期]
内容审核两向夹击中对自身裁量权盲区的低估 [学界/记者/两党-2019~2021]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求驱动其抗拒外部制衡、亲自认领全部责任
causal_rules.disposition: 以'我创建、我运营、我负责'姿态集中决策权，拒绝分权
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 拒绝Yahoo收购、维持双重股权结构、'I started Facebook, I run it'

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好叠加高自我效能导致平台级豪赌
causal_rules.disposition: 全力押注下一代平台并容忍巨额短期亏损
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 更名Meta all-in元宇宙、开源Llama、'the biggest risk is not taking any risks'

causal_rules.description: 低共情反应使其倾向抽象宏大叙事而钝于具体受害群体信号
causal_rules.disposition: 用connection/mission等抽象名词覆盖具体伤害，延迟行动
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 青少年伤害内部文件被曝仍未及时应对；'squirrel dying'式相关性排序

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求推动'contrarian and right'的强硬人设与少道歉转向
causal_rules.disposition: 偏离主流舆论、抵制迎合，减少公开歉意
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'stopped caring whether people like me'、'became too apologetic ... didn't serve us well'
